guard/30886.htm.text: Border Patrol Sutton: Beyond this castle wall lies Goddard of Elmore territory. Unlike our Aden, I heard that life is very hard in that land. I heard a rumor that the lord of Goddard is a very wicked man and he endlessly squeezes money from his people&
